title: Run the Dashboard Integrated group as one CI job

# Dough Intent Coverage: SEED-382#run-the-integrated-group-as-one-ci-job

**Verdict: Caught.** With the "matches no check" refusal disabled, the maintained test `a frontend pattern matching no spec fails the configuration naming it` (Distribution/tests/support/browser-group-shards.test.mjs:177, `assert.throws` at line 196) failed with `AssertionError: Missing expected exception (Error)`, expected `FAIL: .github/workflows/ci.yml: pattern dashboard/frontend-tests/retired/** of share 1 matches no check.` The claim is limited to the observed path: a browser group (dashboard-frontend) selecting through `dashboardTestMatch` (dashboard/tests/support/testFiles.mjs) into `selectShare` (scripts/test-share-matrix.mjs), for the unsplit run, share 1 and the last share. The retarget from the integrated group to the frontend group kept the proof live.

**Next proof action:** none needed for this promise on this path; the maintained assertion catches the fault. No repair decision arises from the probe, and no prior disposition was matched.

## Evidence

- Story and revision: SEED-382#run-the-integrated-group-as-one-ci-job (`.planning/seeds/SEED-382-browser-test-job-headroom-on-slow-runners.md`), revision d9e36d5f1981f9530f1cbbecfa2335204674d392, in a detached scratch worktree under /private/tmp (pre-probe `git status` clean; Node v24.21.0; `node scripts/setup-native.mjs npm` completed).
- Promise (dashboard/tests/shards.md, "The split"): the configuration refuses, before any test is selected, a pattern that matches no spec, naming it.
- Caller suggestions validated and reused unchanged: the fault location, the focused command and the retargeted test all hold at this revision. The refusal lives only in `selectShare`, scripts/test-share-matrix.mjs line 65-67; testFiles.mjs imports it.
- Fault (single edit, tests and fixtures intact): scripts/test-share-matrix.mjs line 65, `if (matched.length === 0) {` changed to `if (false && matched.length === 0) {`.
- Focused command: `PATH=/opt/homebrew/bin:$PATH bash scripts/test.sh Distribution/tests/support/browser-group-shards.test.mjs`.
- Baseline: exit 0, no output. Reach confirmed separately with `node --test --test-reporter=spec` on the same file: 9 tests, 9 pass, including `a frontend pattern matching no spec fails the configuration naming it`.
- Independent wrong-behavior witness (scratch script outside the worktree, not the maintained test): `dashboardTestMatch` for job `dashboard-frontend` against a copy of ci.yml with `dashboard/frontend-tests/retired/**` prepended to share 1. Unfaulted: unsplit, 1/2 and 2/2 each REFUSED with `pattern dashboard/frontend-tests/retired/** of share 1 matches no check.` Faulted: all three returned a selection with no refusal (277, 0 and 277 match patterns). Limit of the witness: its workflow copy sat outside the repository, so the per-share counts are not the real partition; it establishes only that the refusal stopped happening.
- Faulted run of the focused command: exit 1; `FAIL: Distribution/tests/support/browser-group-shards.test.mjs`, `not ok: a frontend pattern matching no spec fails the configuration naming it`, `Missing expected exception (Error)`. That was the only `not ok` line.
- Restoration: `git checkout -- scripts/test-share-matrix.mjs`; `git status --short` and `git diff` empty, HEAD still d9e36d5f1981f9530f1cbbecfa2335204674d392; witness refuses again; focused command exit 0. Scratch worktree and witness directory then removed; the main checkout and its other worktrees were not touched.
- Not examined: the other maintained checks of the same refusal (Distribution/tests/support/dashboard-declared-shards.test.mjs, test-share-matrix.test.mjs) were not run; no wide suite was run.

## Cost

- **Test runtime:** about 1 second wall clock per focused runner invocation (baseline about 1 s, faulted under 1 s, restored about 1 s; four runner invocations in all), measured with whole-second shell timestamps; the direct `node --test` reach run reported duration_ms 448, measured by the test runner.
- **Human effort:** unavailable; no human time was observed during this agent-run check.
- **Agent effort:** 7 tool operations before the finisher (measured count); token usage unavailable, not exposed to the agent.


- **Invocation-to-report elapsed.** 67057 ms (measured), from 1794971527000 to 1794971594057 in Unix epoch ms. The end clock was sampled after writing the prepared report body.

Wrap-up disposition: checked revision d9e36d5f1981f9530f1cbbecfa2335204674d392, verdict Caught, no follow-up.
